text:
Asha (pm): Quick sync request — need to prioritize the next console workstream for 'eyes on inference' v1. Customers keep asking for: dashboard slices, lightweight tracing hooks, token-level cost breakdown, and error analytics. Can we align on minimum launch surface by EOW?

Kai (eng): +1. My main concern is tracing hooks — they can balloon complexity if we try to support full-span capture. Suggest: start with sampled async trace headers and a single integration point (http/gRPC).

Lena (obs): Agreed with Kai. Proposal: config flags to opt-in tracing per-tenant, and a tracing shim that tags requests with `x-rw-trace-id`. That gets us visibility without full distributed tracing plumbing.

Tom (data): For cost breakdown, we can deliver a per-request token cost column in dashboards if we commit to a stable cost model for the model versions we ship with. Need the list of models+quantization tiers to bake unit cost.

Asha (pm): Good call. Customer asks: Priya — can you share the fin-serv and high-throughput startup asks? Which of these are blocking purchase decisions?

Priya (customer-sd): From AcmeBank: token-level cost + anomaly alerts on monthly spend are blockers. From Streamly: tracing to link user requests <> latent retries for SLAs. Both want something low-friction to test in dev first.

Kai (eng): So we should split into three deliverables: 1) Dashboard v1 (token cost column + top-k error types), 2) Tracing shim (header + sampling + link to traces), 3) Alerts & cost anomalies (threshold-based + simple ML anomaly detector later). Which is MVP?

Lena (obs): Dashboard v1 + tracing shim is the MVP for a 6-week cycle. Alerts can be alpha in parallel but gated. We should define launch criteria.

Asha (pm): Proposed launch criteria for MVP (please thumbs if you agree):
```
- Dashboard v1: shows per-route token cost, 90/95 latency percentiles, and top-5 error reasons.
- Tracing shim: `x-rw-trace-id` is emitted for 100% of requests, sampling forwards a link to our trace UI for 1% of requests.
- Security: tracing header cannot contain PII.
- Perf: dashboard queries return <2s for 30d window.
- QA: two customer signoffs (AcmeBank, Streamly) on staging tests.
```

Tom (data): Addability: dashboards need a pre-aggregated token_cost_daily table to avoid expensive queries. I'll own that. ETA 2 weeks if model list is final.

Kai (eng): I'll own tracing shim; estimate 2 weeks for header + sampling + small exporter to our existing trace store. Can we reuse the sampling config from eng-runtime?

Lena (obs): Yes reuse is fine, but we need policy for disabling traces per-tenant. I'll add opt-out metadata. Also will write frontend stubs for links.

Priya (customer-sd): Can we get a short customer-facing test plan? AcmeBank needs steps to enable token cost in a sandbox. I can draft and run with them.

Asha (pm): Assignments then: Tom -> pre-agg table & cost model (due 2w). Kai -> tracing shim & exporter (2w). Lena -> dashboard front + opt-out + QA (3w). Priya -> customer test plan & staging signups. I'll stitch into roadmap and push a tentative canary launch 6w out.

ops-bot: Reminder: Please add rollout policy to the ticket and set a canary flag for 10% traffic for 1 day before 100% rollout.

Kai (eng): One more ask: can we hard-limit trace payload size at the edge to avoid perf regressions? I'll add that to the spec.

Asha (pm): Good catch. Add acceptance criteria item: trace header and payload size < 2KB.

Lena (obs): Also propose an observability smoke test checklist for launch day. I'll upload to the runbook doc and link it in the ticket.

Tom (data): If we hit a data cost problem, we should have a fallback: revert to sampled-only token cost telemetry (daily sampling). Let's include rollback steps.

Asha (pm): Perfect. I'll create the feature epic and break into three tickets tonight. If nobody objects I'll mark this as the prioritized delivery for team alpha. :thumbsup:

Priya (customer-sd): :thumbsup: Customers will appreciate the focused cut. I'll coordinate sandbox signups.

Kai (eng): Sounds good. I'll post a short design doc with the header format and exporter config by EOD tomorrow.

Lena (obs): And I'll draft the dashboard wireframe — small and actionable.

Asha (pm): Thanks all. Closing the loop here — will post the epic link once created.
